tells: 1. Face close shows game-asset skin: uniform orange-waxy diffuse, no pores or subsurface falloff, a hard painted shadow under the nose and flat glassy eyes with no wet-line or lid thickness; the lips are a rigid mesh flap (club-4-face.png, centre face)

2. DOF is a cut-out matte: a dark halo/fringe rings every blurred background figure and the hero's shoulder, a classic depth-mask edge (club-4-face.png, left blonde and right man; club-6-held.png, dark fringe around shoulders)

3. Back rows are flat black cardboard silhouettes standing in fog with identical grey value and no rim, no seat contact and no variation, reading as a 2D cut-out layer (club-1-wide.png, upper-middle band behind the tables)

4. Everyone sits rigidly front-on with hands placed flat on round tables in the same pose; hands hover/float on table tops with no contact shadow or weight transfer, and legs pass through table bases (club-1-wide.png, centre tables; club-6-held.png, hands on table)

5. Candle cups are self-lit pink boxes that throw almost no warm bounce up onto hands and faces; the faces are lit by an unmotivated even front key instead (club-2-mid.png, table candles; club-1-wide.png, front row)

1. Rows are stacked uniform mannequins: identical upright posture, hands on knees, standing-height figures behind seated ones, with bodies floating above the seats rather than sinking into them (theatre-1-wide.png, whole front block and rear rows)

2. Faces in the middle rows are lit flat and pale like emissive cut-outs; no seat-back occlusion falls on them and they don't sit in the darkness of the house (theatre-2-mid.png and theatre-6-held.png, second row: pale man upper-left, olive-shirt man centre)

3. Face close: dead blue-grey eyes with no catchlight structure, a black hole of a mouth with no teeth/tongue shading, and hair as a solid blonde helmet with no strand breakup (theatre-4-face.png, centre)
4. Background crowd is a stack of black silhouettes with uniform value plus far-row people standing in the aisles in identical A-poses (theatre-1-wide.png, left edge figure and upper rows)

5. Laugh strip: only mouths open and heads tilt a few degrees; shoulders, chests and arms don't move, so the laugh is a face swap not a body event; no motion blur between 0.2 s frames (theatre-5-strip.png, front row across all six frames)

1. Face close: smooth plastic skin with baked-in shading, painted brows and a hard specular-free nose; hair is a low-poly card shell with a shimmering jagged edge at the ear and nape (openmic-4-face.png, centre head and ear)
2. DOF halo: a dark matte fringe outlines the blurred hoodie at left and the blonde at right, and the blur is too uniform for a real lens (openmic-4-face.png, left shoulder and right figure)

3. Seated bodies don't load chairs: hands rest stiffly on knees in identical pose, thighs show no compression, and the second row's heads float with no visible bodies or seats (openmic-1-wide.png, front row; openmic-3-mid.png, rear rows)

4. Wall downlights are perfect bloomed discs evenly spaced, with no fixture geometry, and they cast no pools on the wall; the warm side wall is a flat gradient with no texture (openmic-1-wide.png and openmic-2-mid.png, top band)

5. Crowd at far right has a hard, unlit red-jacket figure who looks pasted on with no shadow on the dark wall behind, and a dark empty void below the front row with no floor contact (openmic-3-mid.png and openmic-6-held.png, right edge and bottom)
